name: Rain of Darts
body:
School evocation [force]; Level sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a dart)

EFFECT

Range personal
Area all foes within a 30-ft. radius centered on you
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You rain down on your nearby foes with magic darts by the dozen. All targets within 30 feet of you take 1d4+1 points of force damage.
